description: Use this when the user asks what a dental procedure costs in a Canadian province, for one of 9 procedures: recall exam, scaling (per unit), one-surface composite filling, simple extraction, molar root canal, complete denture, cast partial denture, ceramic crown, single implant. Returns the amount in Canadian dollars per row from the provincial suggested-fee guide or the listed source, with its source URL and an estimated badge where the dataset marks one (open dataset, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20744781, 10 provinces; territories return no_source_at_this_level). Rows under a data-quality review are withheld with their issue number. Phrasings: "what does a crown run in Alberta", "root canal fees in Nova Scotia", "¿cuánto cuesta una limpieza dental en Ontario?", "costo de un implante dental en Columbia Británica". Do not use for: diagnosis, treatment choice, a named insurer's plan price, dentist recommendations, countries other than the US and Canada. Observed market research with a source URL and period on every figure; not a quote, not medical advice.

procedure.description: Optional procedure key; all 9 when omitted.

province.description: Two-letter Canadian province or territory code. One of: AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, NT, NU, ON, PE, QC, SK, YT.

name: canada_dental_cost_by_province
title: Dental cost by Canadian province
